reason: A chat-interface visualization plugin that monitors opencode.ai quota usage across 5-hour, weekly, and monthly windows, with provider filtering and reset countdowns.

summaries.zh: 在聊天界面显示并监控 opencode.ai 的 5 小时、本周和本月额度使用进度及重置倒计时。
summaries.en: Displays and monitors opencode.ai quota usage for 5-hour, weekly, and monthly windows with reset countdowns in the chat interface.

capabilities: Displays 5-hour, weekly, and monthly usage progress in the chat interface
Fetches usage data from opencode.ai using a configured workspace ID and authentication cookie
Stores workspace configuration and authentication data in a local configuration file
Exposes local host routes for configuration and usage retrieval
Runs curl through a subprocess to retrieve the usage page
